title: PORT-BRANCH-web-bot-auth-1: carry web-bot-auth-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `web-bot-auth-1` at 00991c9294 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/deploy-site.yml, site/agentic.js, site/webbotauth.js, site/webbotauth.test.mjs)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/web-bot-auth-1 is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 4 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for web-bot-auth-1
